caption: The drawing depicts a single ornate object resembling a large, stylized wing with a curved, scroll-like extension. The main body of the object is elongated, tapering at both ends, with one end curling into a hook and the other ending in a tighter spiral. The central portion features carved feather-like details arranged in graduated lengths, suggesting layers of feathers, and an area with shallow relief carvings that appear worn. The coloration consists primarily of subdued shades of gray and light brown, with some areas showing signs of aging or wear, such as small patches of tan and ochre. The background is plain, off-white, and unembellished, causing the object to stand out clearly against it. The object is depicted in a flat, side profile with its long axis oriented horizontally across the page.
title: Woodcarving - Wing
